title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (17/20): The Forgetting Virus
note_en: Look at 虽然……却…… in 苏云研发出的新药虽然不能恢复已经消失的记忆，却能阻止病毒继续扩散 "although the new drug couldn't bring back lost memories, it could stop the virus spreading." Chinese happily pairs 虽然 (although) with 却 or 但是 (but) in the same sentence, while English uses only one of them. Note also that 虽然 comes after the subject here (新药虽然…), and 却 always sits right before the verb, never at the start of the clause like English "but."
